claimsFromTheApp.note: launchModelPresets prints the sections to the log pane BEFORE appending the trailing port line, so the pane and the POST body differ by that line; the posted bytes and the file bytes are identical (recorded here). The two capture-legacy-disable-* sections are the Q17 legacy-disableReasoning pair, the mmproj line comes from window.models. Section order is Object.entries(localStorage) insertion order (§9 trap 6).

gaps.reason: a section with no stored config behind it is invisible: every recorded section name matches a stored config in the same recording, so nothing shows what happens to an unsaved form
whether an ini key is emitted when its field holds a retired enum value is not recorded; no recording writes an ini while a control holds a retired value
the key order inside a section is only observable per recorded document; the three recordings agree but a key that never appears in them has no position

insertionOrderRule.fact: section order is JSON.parse(localStorage.llamaCppConfigs) insertion order, not alphabetical; the rendered config list is sorted separately (§9 trap 6)
